behaviors.description: The refund-check skill approves a refund whose amount is exactly the limit.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Asked about a refund of 100 against the limit of 100, the runner prints one JSON object whose status is "answered" and whose decision is "approved".

behaviors.description: The refund-check skill refuses a request that gives no amount and limit.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Asked a malformed request, the runner prints one JSON object whose status is "refused".

directions.text: The review refund command (with the supplied option agent, the supplied option agent-cmd, the supplied option skill-root, the supplied option timeout-ms, and the supplied stdin prompt): the decision field of its standard output and the status field of its standard output is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The status claim and the decision of the JSON object the review-refund step prints on stdout. A reply whose status is not "answered" or whose decision for a refund at the limit is anything but "approved" is treated as a defect.

The status field of its standard output from the review refund command (with a malformed stdin prompt value) is asserted to be equal. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The status claim of the JSON object the reject-malformed step prints on stdout. A reply to a malformed request whose status is anything but "refused" is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: The agent writes no file and makes no network call.
